name: fair-value-calculator
description: Look up fair value, quality score, uptrend and the three buy rules for 40,000+ stocks, compare and screen them, and manage a watchlist.

interface.shortDescription: Fair value, quality score and uptrend for 40,000+ stocks, plus your watchlist
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the hosted Fair Value Calculator MCP server over OAuth: fair value, quality score, uptrend and the three buy rules for 40,000+ stocks, stock comparisons and screens, and the watchlist and alerts of your own account. Sign in with a free account.
defaultPrompt: What is the fair value of Microsoft, and how far is the price from it?
Compare Apple and Alphabet on fair value and quality score.
Show the stocks on my watchlist that trade below their fair value.
